sections.heading: Syllabus Details
rows: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2

Study hour (150h) = '-Self-paced online learning: 15 hours - Learning face-to-face with an instructor: 10 sessions (1 session/week x 10 weeks; 2,25 hrs/session) - Guest speakers' Sharing - Seminars: 3 sessions (2,25 hrs/session) - Mentors' Mentoring: 2 (2,25hr/session). 1-3 additional sessions can be set up depending on the necessity and on the mentor's avaibility. - 102h self-study

In Experiental Entrepreneurship 2, groups of students will develop product/service for their start-up ideas prepared from Experiental Entrepreneurship 1 and deploy sales and find real customers for their group's products/services. There is no mandatory content for this course, just a list of suggested lectures/talks that students can view to get useful tips and experiences for project realization. In addition, there will be seminars and workshops with related topics planned and implemented each semester according to actual needs and implementation situation.

- Students must attend at least 80% of Instructor's Coaching sections, Seminars and Mentor's Mentoring. - Students are responsible for doing all exercises and assignments given by the instructor in class or at home and submitting them on time. - Students must meet all milestones' requirements. - Promplty access to the learning material platform https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up to date course information.
- A hall for seminars has a capacity of at least 200 people

sections.heading: Table 4
rows: Week 1 Instructor's coaching Design for Startups - Part 1
Watch video lectures below: https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7G-design-for-startups-part-1-sus-2018 - (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
Present the group's implementing plan and the project's progress compared to the plan
Week 1 Seminar 1 “Be Successful in Your Own Way” – Guest speaker
EXE201_Tai lieu huong dan nhom mon Trai nghiem khoi nghiep_V5_Tu SU23
- Attend the seminar During Seminar: - Prepare questions for Guest speakers
Week 2 Instructor's coaching Design for Startups, Part 2
Watch video lectures below: https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7H-design-for-startups-part-2-sus-2018 - (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup

- Follow the instructions and requirements of the Lecturer, review assigned video lectures - Present the progress of building product/service and demonstrate the result - Modify plan regarding lecturer's comments - Keep developing product/service
Watch video lectures below: https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7s-building-product-sus-2018 - (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
- Preparing the list of posible channels for launching product/service
Week 3 Seminar 2 “Choosing a Startup Idea” – Guest Speaker
- Attend the seminar During Seminar: - Prepare questions for Guest speakers
Before mentoring: Prepare questions During mentoring: discuss and require guidance from the mentor. After mentoring: Put into practice the knowledge and try to deepen it in the project.
Week 4 Instructor's coaching How to Launch (Again and Again)
Watch video lectures below: https://www.ycombinator.com/library/6i-how-to-launch-again-and-again - (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
- Present market analysis and problem statement, give insign information from its market research - Present the selected channels for launching. - Improve the product/service if needed
Week 5 Instructor's coaching How to get your first ten customers? Oucome 2 presentation
Watch video lectures below: https://www.ycombinator.com/library/9h-how-to-get-your-first-ten-customers - (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
Presents launching situation (channels, methods, cost, market fit, customer target, primilary feedback,…)
Acquire the guidance of the mentor and put it into practice.
Week 6 Instructor's coaching How to Get Users and Grow
Watch video lectures below: https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7K-how-to-get-users-and-grow-sus-2018 - (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
Keep improving product/service if needed Keep launching product/service on selected channels
Acquire the guidance of the mentor and put it into practice.
Week 7 Instructor's coaching How to Sell
Prepare the feedback form and send it to at least 20 people. Collect feedback answers and analyze them. Keep improving product/service if needed Keep launching product/service on selected channels
Week 8 Instructor's coaching How to Set KPIs and Goals
Present the feedback analysis and improvement plan if there is. Keep improving product/service if needed Keep launching product/service on selected channels

Week 8 Seminar 3 Recommended topics: How to do market research – Instructor or Guest speaker MVP and How to Shorten Time-To- Market – Guest speaker “Startup Fundraising & Venture Investment” – Guest speaker
- Attend the seminar During Seminar: - Prepare questions for Guest speakers
Acquire the guidance of the mentor and put it into practice.
Week 9 Instructor's coaching Growth for Startups
Present the feedback analysis, improvement plan if there is. Keep improving product/service if needed Keep launching product/service on selected channels Prepare the final report
Week 10 Evaluate all the groups 1 session offline
Present the startup project and results
Week 11-14 Relaunch & try to approach customers again if previously failed

sections.heading: 3 assessment(s)
rows: - In class, by instructor - Students demonstrate the product/service to the class - Product/service should run well and be market- ready
See rubric at Material link (Schedule sheet, line1) Instructor has resposibility to review the group's demonstration for students.
- In class, by instructor - Students need to submit the required document, and do a presentation in class
See rubric at Material link (Schedule sheet, line1) Instructor has resposibility to review the group's presentation for students.
- In class, by instructor and mentor - Students need to submit the sales results along with all needed proof to the instructor - Students will present their result in class
See rubric at Material link (Schedule sheet, line1) Instructor has resposibility to review the group's presentation for students after graded.
